clauses.quote: Any Department Chairperson serving since 1981-82 whose factor has been retrogressed because of the new ranking of job responsibilities shall continue with the 1981-82 rate of pay until the current factor results in an increase.
clauses.subject_text: Any Department Chairperson serving since 1981-82 whose factor has been retrogressed because of the new ranking of job responsibilities

clauses.quote: Unit members serving as department chairs in 1987 88 and who continue in that position shall continue to be remunerated as appropriate at factor E or F.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members serving as department chairs in 1987 88 and who continue in that position

clauses.quote: High school librarians shall be given stipends at the 1-6 level.
Intramural coaches will receive a weekly compensation based upon three percent (3%) of Class III, Step 7 at the intermediate level and Class III Step 8 at the high school level divided by 11.
Intramural coaches at alternative sites shall receive compensation based on three percent (3%) of Class III, Step 8,
Intramural coaches at alternative sites shall be excluded from provisions in 7.7.4.1.2 below.
clauses.notes: Exclusion from a provision grants separate treatment; benefits workers by removing restrictive conditions.

clauses.quote: If there are more than fifty (50) participants in any intramural program, an additional coach may be added.
clauses.notes: Passive construction implies district discretion to hire/add staff based on participation thresholds.
